p02_window

Early morning inside a small old Japanese room on the second floor. A large open window with sheer white lace curtains billowing inward in the wind, pale pink cherry blossom petals drifting in, soft warm sunlight streaming in with visible light rays and floating dust. Outside the window a quiet harbor town in light sea fog. A wooden desk under the window with handwritten sheet music, a guitar pick and a mug. Pastel pink, cream and pale blue palette.
p03_slope

View from the top of a steep narrow slope street in a small Japanese seaside town in the morning. The road goes down toward a tiny local train station at the bottom by the sea. Old houses with tiled roofs, stone walls, utility poles and electric wires, a cherry tree in bloom with petals in the air. Morning sea fog over the calm sea and a small lighthouse in the distance. A tiny schoolgirl carrying a big guitar case on her back walks down the slope, seen from behind, very small in frame.
p04_puddles

Low angle view along a wet concrete breakwater path at dawn right after rain. Many puddles reflect the pastel dawn sky. The path leads to a small white lighthouse at the far end. Sea fog lifting off the water, a few seagulls, rusty bollards and coiled ropes. Hopeful soft light, cool blue and pale pink palette.
p05_skysea

Breathtaking aerial view high above a sea of fog at sunrise. A small harbor town, its breakwater and a white lighthouse peek through the fog far below. Green mountains rise out of the fog. The sun rises on the horizon with golden light. Vast sky with high cirrus clouds. A small white ferry far below leaves a long wake on the shining sea.
p06_schoolyard

A Japanese high school schoolyard just after rain. Overcast grey sky with sunlight breaking through the clouds. Big puddles reflect the sky. White painted running track lines on the dark wet dirt ground. The school building with many windows and a clock, a large cherry tree, a soccer goal. Fresh humid air, nostalgic quiet mood.
p19_chalk

Close-up at ground level of thick white chalk lines on a wet dirt schoolyard ground, partly smudged and fading. Small puddles reflect the cloudy sky. A few fallen cherry petals. Shallow depth of field, soft overcast light.
p20_case

An old worn black hard guitar case covered with faded travel stickers, leaning against a wooden wall beside the entrance of an old Japanese house. Morning sunlight comes through the open doorway, floating dust motes in the light beam, a pair of shoes at the genkan. Warm nostalgic mood, shallow depth of field.
p08_hands

Close-up of two hands at night, each holding one half of a sugar-glazed donut that has just been broken in two, under a warm streetlamp in light fog. Sugar crumbs fall, faint breath steam in the cold air, beautiful bokeh of harbor lights in the background. Warm amber and teal palette, shallow depth of field.
p10_barwindow

Night in a narrow alley of an old Japanese harbor town. The front of a tiny old bar: a weathered wooden door, a frosted glass lamp, a small wooden signboard with the single kanji 凪, and a large window glowing with warm yellow light. Through the window a cozy interior with a counter and a tiny stage is softly visible. Light rain and mist, wet stone pavement reflecting the warm light. Straight-on view of the window.
p12_city

At night, looking across a dark calm sea toward a big distant port city on the horizon. Bright city lights, skyscrapers and elevated highways glowing orange and white. No fog. A clear deep blue starry sky with the milky way. The city lights reflect on the water. A lone ferry with small lights in the middle distance.
p13_lighthouse

Night, thick sea fog. A white lighthouse at the end of a long breakwater with its lamp glowing softly. A row of old streetlamps along the seawall glow as soft blurry halos in the fog. Dark navy sea with gentle waves. Mysterious and quiet, deep blue palette, no people.
p14_ferry

Bright summer morning on the open sea. A white passenger ferry with a blue stripe crosses calm sparkling cyan water. Seagulls fly around the ship. Huge towering cumulus clouds, a distant green island on the horizon, sunlight glittering on the waves. Vivid and refreshing.
